verses.1: And now, to you, priests, is this commandment.
verses.2: If you do not listen, and if you do not take my words seriously, then I say, “Lord, your army!” I have sent the curse upon you. I will also destroy your blessings. And I will also destroy her blessings, because you do not take my words seriously.
verses.3: I am angry with you for this seed. I have scattered it before your faces, as a symbol of your festivals. I will take you there.
verses.4: And know that I have sent you this commandment: to be my covenant with Levi. As the Lord, the Almighty, said.
verses.5: My covenant was with him—life and peace. I gave them to him as a gift. He feared me, and because of my name, he trembled.
verses.6: The truthful teaching was in his mouth, but it could not be found in his words. In peace and harmony, he led me along. Many were freed from their troubles.
verses.7: For the lips of the priest shall preserve knowledge and wisdom. He shall seek them from his mouth, for Jehovah is the God of hosts.
verses.8: And you have strayed from the path of righteousness. You have broken many laws of the Torah. You have broken the covenant with God. The Lord, the Almighty, said: “You have broken your covenant.”
verses.9: And I have also given you humble and lowly ones to be servants of all people, just as those who do not keep my laws and who do not obey my commands.
verses.10: May one father be our common father. May there be one God who created us all. Let no one break the covenant of our ancestors.
verses.11: Juda’s pride and arrogance led to their downfall in Israel and Jerusalem. This happened because Judah violated the holiness of Yahweh, who loves his people. They also insulted the daughter of El.
verses.12: The LORD will recognize the man who builds and repairs the houses of Jacob, and who offers sacrifices to the LORD’s armies.
verses.13: And this will be done once again: They will cover the altar of Yahweh with dirt. They will cover it from whatever has been exposed to the world before, and they will take away your desires from you.
verses.14: And you said, “What is the reason for this? After all, Jehovah will testify between you and your sister, who is your companion and your wife.”
verses.15: And not one alone did he create; the rest of the spirits also belong to him. What does that one seek? It’s about the seed of God. And they shall be preserved in their spirits and in the fire of your youth, so that they won’t be destroyed.
verses.16: For he desired to send an envoy, said Jehovah, the God of Israel. And He covered him with a veil over his face. “May the armies of Jehovah protect you in your flight, and may they not harm you,” said Jehovah.
verses.17: May the LORD hear your words and take notice of what you say. May you do good and evil in accordance with what the LORD desires. Who is this judge, if not the God of judgment?
